description: Figure 3 illustrates the number of datasets conceptualized and operationalized as targets by year, along with the distribution of datasets categorized as targeted versus untargeted. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled from 2016 to 2022 in sequential order, with linear scaling. The vertical axis represents the number of datasets, labeled from 0 to 100 in increments of 10, with a linear scale. Two sets of bars are presented for each year: a yellow bar representing “Targeted” datasets and a blue bar representing “Untargeted” datasets. In 2016, the “Targeted” bar reaches approximately 18 datasets, while the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 74 datasets. In 2022, the “Targeted” bar reaches approximately 94 datasets, and the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 6 datasets. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each year, with the “Targeted” bar consistently positioned to the left of the “Untargeted” bar. The bars are sorted chronologically by year, from 2016 to 2022. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
